projects.title: Projects
projects.lead: Each project is a folder on the server’s disk. Nothing is shared and there are no accounts.
projects.copy: Same identifier as another project of the list: it is an imported copy. Both stay independent.

catalog.title: Catalogue
catalog.lead: The lists of the {{universe}} universe. Shipped items cannot be changed; yours can be removed.
catalog.label: Label

TabAndSocket.name: Tab and socket
TabAndSocket.hint: A tab under the feet slides into a base.

FoldedTent.name: Folded tent
FoldedTent.hint: Flaps fold out under the feet.

NoSupport.name: No support
NoSupport.hint: Nothing under the feet: glue it or stand it.

project.title: Project
project.lead: These settings apply to every blueprint of the project. Each field is saved when you leave it.
project.name: Name
project.styleFrozen: This project already has proposals: its universe and style no longer change. For another style, duplicate it.
project.duplicateLead: A new project, with the same blueprints but without their proposals.
project.styleClauseHint: In English: appended as is at the end of every prompt. A palette is said here.
project.negativeHint: What the generator should avoid. With Krea 2 Turbo, it has no effect.
project.libraryHint: Choosing a style copies it into the project: changing the library changes no project.

Backup.name: Backup
Backup.hint: The whole project, paired images included. For you.

Share.name: Share
Share.hint: Without paired images. To send to someone.

blueprints.title: Blueprints
blueprints.lead: A blueprint describes a pawn: who it is, its size, how many to print. Every field is saved when you leave it.
blueprints.optionalHint: “Generator’s choice”: nothing is asked, the generator decides.
blueprints.outOfListWarning: “{{value}}” is not in the catalogue: it goes into the prompt as is, without a pose phrase.
blueprints.detailsHint: In English, added at the end of the description: “one ear torn”.
blueprints.subject: Subject description
blueprints.optionsInactive: Customised text: the lists and the details no longer change it.
blueprints.resetConfirm: Your text will be replaced by the one the fields compose.
blueprints.subjectHint: Composed from the fields above, in English.
blueprints.promptHint: The framing clause, which sets the pose and the background, is added by the workflow.
blueprints.deleteConfirm_one: Delete this blueprint and its proposal, files included?
blueprints.deleteConfirm_other: Delete this blueprint and its {{count}} proposals, files included?

newEntry.title: New item: {{list}}
newEntry.lead: A complete item, and nothing less: it joins your personal catalogue and serves all your projects.
newEntry.valueHint: In English, stored in the project: “warhammer”.
newEntry.fragmentHint: In English. Starts from an example of the same list: keep the pose it describes, so the item stays inside the silhouette.

generation.title: Generation
generation.lead: Launch a batch of proposals for a blueprint, then sort them: the kept one is the one that will be printed.
generation.noBlueprint: No blueprint: create one in the Blueprints step.
generation.seedsHint: Optional. Numbers separated by spaces: to make an image again, identically.
generation.seedsInvalid: A seed is a positive whole number, in digits.
generation.cutoutFailed: A proposal is kept without cut-outs: {{reason}}
generation.misalignmentUnknown: No workflow is configured: whether the prompt changed since each image cannot be told.
generation.paired: Paired image, not cut out yet
generation.keepNeedsCut: Only a cut-out proposal can be kept: the sheet prints the cut-outs.
generation.framingChanged: The workflow's framing clause changed since this image.

layout.title: Layout
layout.lead: The sheet is computed, not composed: a page holds one size only, and the preview is the PDF itself, marks included.

skip.ElectedCandidateNotFound: Not printed: the kept proposal no longer exists.
skip.ElectedCandidateNotCutOut: Not printed: the kept proposal is not cut out.

layout.empty: Nothing to print: no blueprint has a kept, cut-out proposal.
layout.changeFormat: Change the format or the geometry
layout.misaligned: {{name}}: the kept proposal’s prompt changed since ({{clauses}}). It will be printed as it is.
layout.widthLimited: {{name}} ({{size}}): the image is held back by its width and fills only {{usage}}% of the height ({{printed}} mm of {{available}} mm).

print.title: Print
print.lead: Download the PDF and print it as it is: no scaling, neither here nor in the print dialog.

check.actualSize: Print at “actual size” or 100%, never “fit to page”.
check.ruler: Measure the calibration line at the bottom of the page: it must be exactly 100 mm.
check.correction: If it does not, the printer rescales: correct the calibration’s scale factor before printing again.
check.cut: Cut along the solid lines, fold along the dashed ones.
